title: Guard: Distribution-Free Flags for Enhancement Missed by Virtual-Contrast MRI, with Prior-Guided Synthesis
abstract:
Virtual-contrast synthesis generates post-contrast T1 (T1c) from non-contrast (NC) brain MRI but can omit enhancing
tumour (ET) without showing where. \emph{Guard} adds to any synthesiser's T1c a map of Supported, Check and Unlikely
voxels. Flags follow an NC-only ET score so that, for exchangeable patients, the expected fraction of ET
that the image neither shows nor flags stays below a target $\alpha$. \emph{Guide} gives regression synthesisers
out-of-fold NC lesion maps as input channels. For \NSynth{} synthesisers retrained on a BraTS 2023 split
(\NHeldOutPatients{} held-out patients), $\alpha=0.1$ cost \MarkedMin--\MarkedMax{}\,mL of flagged non-ET tissue,
the review burden (mean ET volume \ETVolMean{}\,mL); an averaged score chosen post hoc gave
\MarkedPMMin--\MarkedPMMax{}\,mL (exploratory). Guide raised ET Dice by \PriorGainFusedDice{} over the same recipe
without it but did not lower the burden. On external gliomas the mean miss exceeded 0.1 by at most
\GliomaExcessMax{} (not significant); on meningiomas the bound failed.

figures.caption:
Guide and Guard on the held-out patient of median ET volume. \emph{Guide}: NC lesion maps $m=h(x,c)$ enter
a 2.5D and a 3D regressor, whose mean is $\hat y$. \emph{Guard}, for any synthesiser: $S$, given $\hat y$ in place of the
acquired T1c, marks the ET that $\hat y$ shows ($\Ehat$); an NC score $s$ ($g$, or the exploratory
$(g+m_{\mathrm{ET}})/2$, dashed) ranks where ET may be missing; CRC/LTT thresholds from separate calibration patients
label each voxel. Labels are algorithmic evidence categories, not diagnoses.}
\label{fig:method

Held-out patients, zoomed (rules fixed in advance): P1 at the 25th percentile of ET volume; P2 a failure
